name: skater squat
description: A single-leg squat with the free leg swept behind, like a speed skater, for leg strength and balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent and the foot lifted behind you.
Swing your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Lightly tap the back knee near the floor.
Stand up through the front foot, then switch legs after your reps.
